# PanDEVbono

> PanDEVbono is a team of developers that designs and builds websites and web apps, deploys them on AWS, Google Cloud (GCP) and Cloudflare, and sets up and manages AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and more) for teams. The site is available in Spanish (default) and English.

PanDEVbono es un equipo de desarrolladores que diseña y desarrolla sitios y aplicaciones web, los despliega en AWS, Google Cloud (GCP) y Cloudflare, y configura y gestiona herramientas de IA para equipos.

## Pages

- [Inicio (español)](https://pandevbono.com/): Página principal en español — servicios, gestión de herramientas de IA, stack tecnológico y preguntas frecuentes.
- [Home (English)](https://pandevbono.com/en): English home page — services, AI tools management, tech stack and FAQ.

## Services

- Web development: websites and web apps with React, Next.js and Angular.
- Cloud & edge: infrastructure on AWS and Google Cloud; Cloudflare for DNS, CDN, Workers and protection.
- AI tools management: choosing, setting up, integrating and managing AI tools — accounts and access, integrations with apps and data (APIs, RAG, agents), usage and security policies, cost and usage control.
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Firebase; MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch.
- Design & UX: Figma and Canva.
- Project management & documentation: Jira, Notion, Airtable, Trello, Docusaurus, Swagger, OpenAPI.
